feeds.title: Matrix Fitness Blog
feeds.description: The Matrix Fitness Blog is the official blog of Matrix Fitness Italia, a division of Johnson Health Tech Italia Spa. The blog is focused on promoting the importance of physical activity and fitness, and features articles on a variety of topics related to health and wellness. The blog also provides news and updates on Matrix Fitness products and events.

feeds.title: Workout-Italia
feeds.description: Workout-Italia is a website that helps people in Italy to lose weight and stay in shape. It offers a variety of resources, including workouts, workout plans, nutrition advice, and more. The website also has a community forum where users can connect with each other and share their experiences.

feeds.title: Fitnessway Blog
feeds.description: Fitnessway operates in the training of technical and managerial figures who carry out professional functions in fitness & wellness centers as well as in the context of sports and tourist organizations. The official Fitnessway blog intends to convey advice, curiosities and insights into the world of fitness and well-being.

feeds.title: Sidea News
feeds.description: Sideaita.net is the website of Sidea Fitness, a company that designs and manufactures fitness equipment. They offer a wide range of products, including barbells, dumbbells, kettlebells, weight plates, mats, benches, and more. They are committed to providing high-quality fitness equipment that is both functional and stylish. Their products are used by athletes and fitness enthusiasts all over the world.

feeds.title: Diadora Fitness Blog
feeds.description: The Diadora Fitness blog is a website that provides tips and advice on how to do fitness exercises at home. It also features information about Diadora's professional fitness equipment, such as treadmills, exercise bikes, spin bikes, weight benches, and weights. The blog is written in Italian.

feeds.title: AnytimeFitness Blog
feeds.description: The Anytime Fitness Italia blog is a website that provides fitness tips, workout routines, and nutrition advice for people in Italy. At the AF community, men and women of all ages, whatever the level of preparation and training. Anyone who has set a goal to achieve and aspires to their psycho-physical well-being, feeling part of a large inclusive and supportive community.

feeds.title: Club Italian Fitness Blog
feeds.description: Club Italian Fitness is a gym for young people and families. They strongly believe in the benefits of Sport and movement and will help you achieve your goals through the activities in the weight room, through one of the many fitness courses, martial arts, or through guided tours relying on various professionals.

feeds.title: Enecta Free Fitness Blog
feeds.description: Enecta Free Fitness is a free and inclusive initiative, created to improve the physical and mental well-being of people of any age, gender, physical shape, and origin. Enecta Free Fitness is aimed at anyone who wants to get moving. Whatever your level of training, the experts will welcome you and give you the support you need, without any kind of judgment or pretension.

feeds.title: NBFI
feeds.description: NBFI is a non-profit, amateur sports association that promotes natural bodybuilding and fitness in Italy. The association is affiliated with the Italian National Olympic Committee (CONI) and the Italian Federation of Sports Aspirants (ASI). The NBFI website provides information on the association's activities, including its competitions, training programs, and seminars.

feeds.title: TRX Italia News
feeds.description: TRX Italia, today Smartfitness Italia brand of Transatlantic Fitness Italia Srl, has been operating in the fitness sector for almost 20 years. Its mission is to promote and protect one of the best-known brands in the world of suspension training and functional training in general.

feeds.title: Vitanova Fitness Blog
feeds.description: Vitanova Fitness's philosophy is a fitness center cannot be just a place with a few dedicated machines. It would be nothing without trained personnel who believe in what they do and in the results you can achieve.

feeds.title: Sifa Formazione Blog
feeds.description: SIFA SRL, the Italian Fitness Nutrition Society, offers courses throughout Italy with national validity with the release of ECM credits, recognized by the MINISTRY OF HEALTH and CONI. The teachers are graduates of motor sciences, doctors, sports nutritionists, and highly specialized technicians.

feeds.title: IBFF Blog
feeds.description: IBFF is the Italian Boxing & Fitness Federation, a combat fitness academy. It is the number 1 combat fitness academy in Italy and has trained hundreds of instructors and thrilled thousands of users. IBFF offers a variety of training courses, including GroupBoxing, GroupSparring, StrikeBoxe, and more. It also sells equipment and apparel for combat fitness enthusiasts.
